title: punish — paradoxically

sentences.sentence: Smacking is not an acceptable way of punishing a child.
sentences.translation: 要惩罚孩子，不应该用打的方式。

sentences.sentence: He promised to punish severely any officials found guilty of electoral fraud.
sentences.translation: 他承诺要严惩任何在选举中有欺诈行为的官员。

sentences.sentence: They deserve to be punished for putting passengers at risk.
sentences.translation: 他们置乘客于危险之中，理应受到惩罚。

sentences.sentence: I felt I was being punished for what my mother had done.
sentences.translation: 我觉得自己在为妈妈的所作所为接受惩罚。

sentences.sentence: Natural philosophy involved the study of all aspects of the material world, animate and inanimate.
sentences.translation: 自然哲学涉及到了对包括有生命体与无生命体的物质世界的全面研究。

sentences.sentence: ...aggressive militaristic governments.
sentences.translation: ...侵略性的军国主义政府。

sentences.sentence: The Palestinians would balk at that as far too much, even if they got the equivalent acreage back, perhaps adjacent to the Gaza Strip.
sentences.translation: 巴基斯坦方对于这个提议望而却步，即便他们能换回同样多的英亩数，还有可能得到加沙地带的邻近区域。

sentences.sentence: The prevailing price levels for critical commodities should see a significant acreage response in the coming months as countries begin their cultivation cycles.
sentences.translation: 现行价格水平为关键的商品应该会看到一个显着的反应面积在未来数月随着各国开始他们的培养周期。

sentences.sentence: Convinced of his own righteousness, he was the perfect impersonation of a man of rectitude.
sentences.translation: 他确信自己很正直，可以完美地扮演刚正不阿的人。

sentences.sentence: It could just be a cyst that would either reabsorb itself into the body or need to be surgically removed.
sentences.translation: 它也有可能仅仅是一个囊肿，能被身体再吸收或者通过手术就可以把它给切除掉。

sentences.sentence: Building huge air-capture plants to reabsorb the carbon dioxide produced by burning fossil fuels would be a perverse outcome.
sentences.translation: 建造超大型空气捕捉站来重吸收二氧化碳也许会出人意料的产生可燃烧的化石燃料。

phrases.translation: 过盈配合；干涉配合；紧配合
抗干扰能力；干扰抑制；抗干扰度；抗扰性
射频干扰；无线电频率干扰
相消干涉，相消干扰；破坏性干扰

sentences.sentence: Industrial relations should be free from state interference.
sentences.translation: 劳资关系应不受政府干预。

sentences.sentence: We saw the canoe overturn, throwing its passengers into the water.
sentences.translation: 我们看到独木舟倾覆了，把上面的乘客掀入水中。

phrases.translation: 打架；一决雌雄；用拳头猛击

sentences.sentence: the Duke of Norfolk
sentences.translation: 诺福克公爵

sentences.sentence: He turned and faced her squarely.
sentences.translation: 他转过身来和她正面相对。

sentences.sentence: She hit him squarely on the nose.
sentences.translation: 她不偏不倚地打在他的鼻子上。

sentences.sentence: It was built for one of the Henderson family, right?
sentences.translation: 它是为了亨德森家族的一个成员建的，对吧？

sentences.sentence: Come to the Henderson Language School and change your life.
sentences.translation: 来到亨德森语言学校，就会改变你的一生。

sentences.sentence: In 1950, roughly one in 20 men of prime working age, like Henderson, was not working; today that ratio is about one in five, the highest ever recorded.
sentences.translation: 1950年，大约每20名处于适龄工作年龄的男人中，就有一名像亨德森这样没有工作的；现在这一比例约为五分之一，是历史最高纪录。

sentences.sentence: Now if we could only figure out the pronoun problem.
sentences.translation: 现在我们可以解决这个代词问题了。

sentences.sentence: He was being held prisoner.
sentences.translation: 他正遭囚禁。

sentences.sentence: Our pilot was taken prisoner .
sentences.translation: 我们的飞行员被抓起来了。

sentences.sentence: The army advanced, taking 200,000 prisoners .
sentences.translation: 军队向前推进，抓获20万名俘虏。

sentences.sentence: Most seasonal hiring is done in early October.
sentences.translation: 多数季节性招聘是在10月初进行。

sentences.sentence: At his belt he carried a rawhide whip.
sentences.translation: 他腰间别着一根生牛皮制作的鞭子。

sentences.sentence: Many causes have been proposed for both the intelligence gap and the Flynn effect, including education, income, and even nonagricultural labor.
sentences.translation: 人们对智力差距和弗林效应提出了许多成因，包括教育、收入，甚至还包括非农业劳动。

sentences.sentence: There has been "good" progress in persuading locals, mostly people engaged in nonagricultural activities, to give up land, she says.
sentences.translation: 她指出，针对当地居民的说服工作已经取得喜人的进展，大部分未从事农业活动的居民表示愿意放弃土地。

sentences.sentence: the Yorkshire Dales National Park
sentences.translation: 约克郡山谷国家公园

sentences.sentence: The war brought massive devastation and loss of life to the region.
sentences.translation: 战争给该地区造成巨大的破坏以及生命的丧失。

sentences.sentence: Paradoxically, the prohibition of liquor caused an increase in alcoholism.
sentences.translation: 矛盾的是，禁酒反而导致酗酒的增加。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 279 单元

punish
音标：英 /'pʌnɪʃ/  美 /'pʌnɪʃ/
v. 惩罚,处罚
短语：punish for — v. 处罚，惩罚
短语：punish with — 用...惩罚
例句：Smacking is not an acceptable way of punishing a child.
要惩罚孩子，不应该用打的方式。
例句：He promised to punish severely any officials found guilty of electoral fraud.
他承诺要严惩任何在选举中有欺诈行为的官员。
例句：They deserve to be punished for putting passengers at risk.
他们置乘客于危险之中，理应受到惩罚。
例句：I felt I was being punished for what my mother had done.
我觉得自己在为妈妈的所作所为接受惩罚。

animate
音标：英 /'ænɪmeɪt/  美 /'ænɪmet/
v. 鼓舞
adj. 生气勃勃的
例句：Natural philosophy involved the study of all aspects of the material world, animate and inanimate.
自然哲学涉及到了对包括有生命体与无生命体的物质世界的全面研究。

militaristic
音标：美 /,mɪlɪtə'rɪstɪk/
adj. 军国主义的
例句：...aggressive militaristic governments.
...侵略性的军国主义政府。

acreage
音标：英 /'eɪk(ə)rɪdʒ/  美 /'ekərɪdʒ/
n. 英亩数, 面积
例句：The Palestinians would balk at that as far too much, even if they got the equivalent acreage back, perhaps adjacent to the Gaza Strip.
巴基斯坦方对于这个提议望而却步，即便他们能换回同样多的英亩数，还有可能得到加沙地带的邻近区域。
例句：The prevailing price levels for critical commodities should see a significant acreage response in the coming months as countries begin their cultivation cycles.
现行价格水平为关键的商品应该会看到一个显着的反应面积在未来数月随着各国开始他们的培养周期。

impersonation
n. 扮演
例句：Convinced of his own righteousness, he was the perfect impersonation of a man of rectitude.
他确信自己很正直，可以完美地扮演刚正不阿的人。

reabsorb
音标：英 /,riːəb'zɔːb; -'sɔːb/  美 /,ri:əb'sɔ:b/
v. 再吸附,重吸收
例句：It could just be a cyst that would either reabsorb itself into the body or need to be surgically removed.
它也有可能仅仅是一个囊肿，能被身体再吸收或者通过手术就可以把它给切除掉。
例句：Building huge air-capture plants to reabsorb the carbon dioxide produced by burning fossil fuels would be a perverse outcome.
建造超大型空气捕捉站来重吸收二氧化碳也许会出人意料的产生可燃烧的化石燃料。

interference
音标：英 /ɪntə'fɪər(ə)ns/  美 /,ɪntɚ'fɪrəns/
n. 冲突, 干涉
短语：interference in — 干涉
短语：electromagnetic interference — 电磁干扰
短语：interference with — 干涉；妨碍，打扰
短语：interference fit — 过盈配合；干涉配合；紧配合
短语：mutual interference — 互相干扰；相互干涉
短语：interference suppression — [计]干扰抑制
短语：interference rejection — 抗干扰能力；干扰抑制；抗干扰度；抗扰性
短语：interference fringe — [电]干涉条纹
短语：radio interference — 无线电干扰；射电干扰
短语：interference pattern — 干涉图样
短语：intersymbol interference — 码间干扰；符号间干扰
短语：interference filter — 干涉滤光片
短语：background interference — 背景干扰；本底干扰
短语：interference microscope — 干涉显微镜
短语：optical interference — 光干涉；光波干扰
短语：harmonic interference — 谐波干涉
短语：interference factor — 干扰因素；干扰因子
短语：radio frequency interference — 射频干扰；无线电频率干扰
短语：harmful interference — 有害干扰
短语：destructive interference — 相消干涉，相消干扰；破坏性干扰
例句：Industrial relations should be free from state interference.
劳资关系应不受政府干预。

overturn
音标：英 /əʊvə'tɜːn/  美 /'ovətɝn/
n. 倾覆, 破灭
v. 推翻, 颠倒
例句：We saw the canoe overturn, throwing its passengers into the water.
我们看到独木舟倾覆了，把上面的乘客掀入水中。

duke
音标：英 /djuːk/  美 /dʊk/
n. 公爵
短语：duke university — 杜克大学
短语：duke it out — 打架；一决雌雄；用拳头猛击
例句：the Duke of Norfolk
诺福克公爵

squarely
音标：英 /'skweəlɪ/  美 /'skwɛrli/
adv. 方形地, 直角地
例句：He turned and faced her squarely.
他转过身来和她正面相对。
例句：She hit him squarely on the nose.
她不偏不倚地打在他的鼻子上。

Henderson
n. 亨德森（姓氏）
例句：It was built for one of the Henderson family, right?
它是为了亨德森家族的一个成员建的，对吧？
例句：Come to the Henderson Language School and change your life.
来到亨德森语言学校，就会改变你的一生。
例句：In 1950, roughly one in 20 men of prime working age, like Henderson, was not working; today that ratio is about one in five, the highest ever recorded.
1950年，大约每20名处于适龄工作年龄的男人中，就有一名像亨德森这样没有工作的；现在这一比例约为五分之一，是历史最高纪录。

pronoun
音标：英 /'prəʊnaʊn/  美 /'pronaʊn/
n. 代名词
短语：personal pronoun — n. 人称代名词
短语：demonstrative pronoun — n. 指示代词
短语：interrogative pronoun — 疑问代词
短语：relative pronoun — [语]关系代词
例句：Now if we could only figure out the pronoun problem.
现在我们可以解决这个代词问题了。

prisoner
音标：英 /'prɪz(ə)nə/  美 /'prɪznɚ/
adj. 囚犯的
n. 战俘
短语：prisoner of war — 战俘
短语：prisoner of war (pow) — n. 战俘
短语：political prisoner — 政治犯
例句：He was being held prisoner.
他正遭囚禁。
例句：Our pilot was taken prisoner .
我们的飞行员被抓起来了。
例句：The army advanced, taking 200,000 prisoners .
军队向前推进，抓获20万名俘虏。

October
音标：英 /ɒk'təʊbə/  美 /ɑk'tobɚ/
n. 十月(略作Oct)
短语：october revolution — 俄国十月革命
例句：Most seasonal hiring is done in early October.
多数季节性招聘是在10月初进行。

rawhide
音标：英 /'rɔːhaɪd/  美 /'rɔhaɪd/
n. 生牛皮
vt. 用生牛皮鞭抽打
adj. 生牛皮的
例句：At his belt he carried a rawhide whip.
他腰间别着一根生牛皮制作的鞭子。

nonagricultural
adj. 非农业的
例句：Many causes have been proposed for both the intelligence gap and the Flynn effect, including education, income, and even nonagricultural labor.
人们对智力差距和弗林效应提出了许多成因，包括教育、收入，甚至还包括非农业劳动。
例句：There has been "good" progress in persuading locals, mostly people engaged in nonagricultural activities, to give up land, she says.
她指出，针对当地居民的说服工作已经取得喜人的进展，大部分未从事农业活动的居民表示愿意放弃土地。

dale
音标：英 /deɪl/  美 /del/
n. 宽谷, 溪谷
例句：the Yorkshire Dales National Park
约克郡山谷国家公园

devastation
音标：英 /,devə'steɪʃn/  美 /,devə'steiʃən/
n. 毁坏,荒废
例句：The war brought massive devastation and loss of life to the region.
战争给该地区造成巨大的破坏以及生命的丧失。

fletcher
音标：英 /'fletʃə/  美 /'fletʃə/
n. <古>造箭者,弗莱彻

paradoxically
音标：英 /,pærə'dɔksikəli/  美 /,pærə'dɔksikəli/
adv. 相矛盾地,似非而是地
例句：Paradoxically, the prohibition of liquor caused an increase in alcoholism.
矛盾的是，禁酒反而导致酗酒的增加。
